title: Latency
acceptance: На lab-standard: 20 virtual users, 10 min after 2min warmup; read p95≤300ms, command acceptance p95≤500ms; saga completion p95≤5s при здоровом PSP; error<1% excluding expected409/422.

title: Integrity
acceptance: 100 concurrent overlapping bookings on one asset produce exactly one committed allocation. Zero overlap, overcapture and duplicate refund across 10k duplicate/reordered deliveries.

title: Tenant isolation
acceptance: Two organizations × all role/endpoint pairs; no foreign records, events, SSE or cache entries; 401/403/404 verified before access.

title: Recovery
acceptance: Broker outage120s, consumer killed after DB commit beforeACK; pending saga reconciles ≤120s after recovery for 100 bookings; DLQ poison remains quarantined.

title: Observability
acceptance: 100% synthetic test traces sampled; booking→outbox→consumer→PSP causality queryable; logs correlate; metrics have no booking/customer label.

title: Availability target
acceptance: Lab SLO 99% successful eligible commands over 1h controlled run (denominator excludes auth/validation/conflict; includes dependency5xx). No claim about monthly production availability.

title: Security
acceptance: TLS on ingress and internal production-like traffic, JWT issuer/audience/expiry checked, secrets absent repository/logs, least-privilege DB/broker roles; security scenario suite passes.

title: Delivery independence
acceptance: Seven service images and DB migration streams; notification-only release changes no other digest; each service tests/builds/deploys without importing other business implementation.

title: Accessibility
acceptance: Keyboard complete customer checkout and operator return; visible focus; labels/errors; no color-only state; contrast normal text≥4.5:1; 360px without horizontal page scroll.

title: Backup
acceptance: Snapshot RPO target≤24h; measured isolated restore RTO≤30min for fixture dataset; reconnect mismatched service snapshots through reconcile, report unrecoverable delta.

title: Data lifecycle
acceptance: Synthetic users only; auth logs7d, telemetry7d, notifications30d, inbox/idempotency24h minimum with replay rules; booking/ledger retained for lab history; scrub demo emails on exports.

title: Reproducibility
acceptance: Clean lab host builds pinned images/contracts; bootstrap docs checked by reviewer; no mandatory external cloud, CDN or paid integration.
